mara.activity: Make coffee and toast, then check the weather and transit alerts at the kitchen island. I leave the blue mug at the island center when I am finished.
mara.intention: Start the day calmly and check for any commute problems.

mara.activity: Wash up, get dressed, and gather my work things. I take my work laptop from the padded backpack on the bedroom-two desk, put it back in the backpack, and carry the backpack to the entry.
mara.intention: Get ready and leave with everything needed for work.

mara.activity: Commute to the municipal office with my work backpack and transit badge.
Work at the municipal office on transportation planning, attend meetings, and review street-project maps. I make notes and keep my phone available for transit updates.
mara.intention: Complete the day’s planning and coordination work.

mara.activity: Commute home, bring the work backpack upstairs, and put the laptop back on the bedroom-two desk before changing out of work clothes.
mara.intention: Return home and put work materials away.

mara.activity: Answer a few messages and sort the incoming mail. I carry the mail stack from the dining table to the sideboard briefly while I separate it, then leave the unsorted pieces in a neat stack at the left end of the dining table.
mara.intention: Clear the day’s small administrative tasks without letting the mail spread across the table.

mara.activity: Do a quick reset of the entry and kitchen counters, putting away anything that has accumulated and returning my keys to the maple console’s left drawer. I move the blue mug back to the kitchen island center if it has been used elsewhere.
mara.intention: Make the house feel settled before dinner.

mara.activity: Take the grocery list from beneath the refrigerator magnet and transfer the useful items to my phone, then return the paper list under the magnet.
mara.intention: Make the Wednesday grocery trip easier without starting it tonight.

mara.activity: Change into comfortable clothes and sit briefly at the dining table while Daniel finishes his transition from work.
mara.intention: Shift out of work mode and be ready for dinner.

mara.activity: Eat dinner and talk with Daniel at the dining table. I set out a plate, fork, and glass for myself and clear them to the kitchen afterward.
Wash my dinner things and make tea. I carry the tea mug and tea to the living room, placing it on the right side of the coffee table.
mara.intention: Prepare for a quiet evening without taking over Daniel’s television time.

mara.activity: Read my library book in the living room with tea. I take my reading glasses from the left nightstand, use them with the book, and leave both on the living-room side table when I finish.
mara.intention: Relax and read a little longer than usual.

mara.activity: Wash up, put on pajamas, and set my phone on its charger. I leave the reading glasses on the living-room side table rather than carrying them back upstairs tonight.
mara.intention: Wind down and prepare for bed.

mara.activity: Get into bed, read a few final pages from the library book, and turn out the light.
mara.intention: End the day quietly and get normal sleep.

daniel.activity: Wake up, brush my teeth, get dressed, and take my allergy tablets.

daniel.intention: Wash up before leaving for the repair calls.

daniel.activity: Pack the repair bag, check my tools, and eat a quick breakfast at the kitchen counter.
daniel.intention: Have breakfast and make sure I have what I need for the route.

daniel.activity: Carry the repair bag and lunch container to the truck, unlock it, put the truck keys on the entry coat rack's middle-right hook, and leave.
daniel.intention: Get out the door for the first appointment.

daniel.activity: Drive between appliance repair calls, diagnose and repair customers' appliances, and take a short lunch break from the lunch container.
daniel.intention: Complete the scheduled Tuesday service route.

daniel.activity: Drive home from the last service call and carry the repair bag inside.
daniel.intention: Return home and put away the day's work gear.

daniel.activity: Change out of my work clothes, put them in the laundry hamper, and check tomorrow's service calls on my phone.
daniel.intention: Clean up after work and prepare for the next route.

daniel.activity: Wash my hands, reheat Mara's prepared food or bring home takeout, and eat at the dining table.
daniel.intention: Have an easy dinner after the route.

daniel.activity: Sit on the sofa, watch television, read sports news, and tighten a small household screw if I notice one.
daniel.intention: Unwind and handle a small definite repair if needed.

daniel.activity: Brush my teeth, take my allergy tablets, and change into sleep clothes.
